title: Chapter 115 Cutting Down On Behalf Of The Sky
content:
Chapter 115 Cutting Down On Behalf Of The Sky

Now, Zhong Yu is officially the supreme emperor, and the opposite is also a divine mansion that harvests the beliefs of countless living beings. The two have essentially the same existence in certain properties, and what will be the result of colliding with each other!

In some facts, the gods are at a disadvantage compared to the emperor, unless the gods can spread their influence to the people of the entire kingdom, forming a kind of suppression of the emperor, then he can achieve certain The advantages.

Just like all the sects on the mainland are so powerful one by one, many countries can't hold their heads up. Except for those super empires, the extremely powerful existence can slightly ignore the voices and opinions of the sects.

The other kingdoms, principalities, which one is not trembling under the coercion of the sect, for fear that one of them will accidentally cause a catastrophe, and be sent by the private military armed forces of the sect to wipe out their own rule.

Even sects don’t even need to send troops, they just need to encourage people from various gods in their kingdom, then maybe the person next to their pillow is a believer in a certain god, and they can get their own heads in their sleep , like his gods took credit for it.

How can this not make the various rulers feel intimidated? Fear is followed by tolerance for sects, and sects use this to develop further.

In this way, a vicious circle is formed, the influence of the kingdom is getting weaker and weaker, and the strength of the sect is getting stronger and stronger. Gradually above the mainland, the kingdom is under the sect.

Now, there are no people in my own country who believe in it, and the so-called God's Mansion on the opposite side doesn't even believe in the local gods of other Three Kingdoms worlds.

Any people who have faith will be strictly shaved off when they return to the main world. Every people can only believe in themselves, His Majesty the Emperor.

For one word of my own, one order, for their glory and wealth, for the promotion of officials and titles, to sacrifice their lives and souls, and everything in order to obtain hard work.

Therefore, it can be said that his imperial power has been unprecedentedly concentrated in this empire. Compared with some believers under his command, the gods with extremely fanatical beliefs are comparable.

Moreover, there are millions of his subjects under his command, ruled by him. On the opposite side, there are only tens of thousands of indigenous beliefs in the divine mansion. Although there are some worshipers from other tribes in the alliance, compared to the collective mind power of all beings, it is still far behind my own.

And he also upholds the rules of the way of heaven, as in ancient Chinese words, he is the son of heaven, leading the heavens to shepherd and guard all living beings, regulating the yin and yang in the world, and being closely connected with the entire way of heaven.

Moreover, the exercises I cultivated can also imitate the breath of the heavenly way to a very realistic level, so as to obtain part of the authority of the heavenly way, and control the laws of the entire heaven and earth for my own use.

For a demigod who also practiced the laws of heaven and was still searching for them without much authority, he was more important in Tiandao's heart than he was!

After such a calculation, in terms of the proportion of the hearts of both sides of Heaven, Dao and Humanity, I have overwhelmed the other side's divine residence, so what else can I be afraid of!

At that time, I can directly issue a decree, representing the heaven and humanity of this world, directly punish that god mansion, deprive him of everything, demote him to a mortal, and lay down the altar.

Just like in ancient China, the king conferred gods and punished gods in various periods, because the king’s thoughts determined the rise and fall of a god’s mansion, and even a single official could determine the rise and fall of a god’s mansion. In the Tang Dynasty, there was not one Is it an accident that Wei Zheng beheaded the Dragon King of Jinghe?

Then, as an emperor, Zhong Yu naturally has the ability to use his decrees to borrow the power of heaven and humanity to punish all gods who want to harm him or offend his authority.

Zhong Yu thinks so now, and he is going to do the same next time, so he is full of confidence and comforts Cao Cao and the others with a smile on his face.

Tell them that the so-called God's residence is not worth mentioning in front of him, they can go back with peace of mind, take a good rest, and recover their exhausted bodies at the moment.

Three days after Cao Cao and others came back, the god Edel of the Edel tribe that Zhong Yu had been waiting for for a long time came. However, what was different from what happened to Cao Cao and others was that Zhong Yu's camp did not encounter any attack from the divine mansion, but it was extremely calm.

But above the sky of the camp, a group of golden light was seen shining, but the majesty contained in the golden light did not fall into the camp, but was tightly wrapped by an invisible coercion Restricted, at the bottom!

This kind of thing is naturally written by Zhong Yu. Long before the arrival of the god's mansion, he spread his aura around the entire camp, arousing the favor of heaven and humanity, and specially set up a layer to target the god's mansion. Or the defense of other supernatural powers.

At this moment, the god Edel, who was arrogant and mighty, came in fiercely, but was panicked and embarrassed like a bereaved dog.

The whole person was trapped in the center by the coercion drawn by Zhong Yu, unable to move, and could only release the coercion that belonged to God to resist reluctantly.

Other than that, there was no other way but to wait slowly for Zhong Yu's disposal. As a result, not only God Edel felt panicked, but even the other demigods watching the battle felt a wave of panic in their hearts. cold.

But what happened next made many demigods panic even more.

From the central tent of the barracks below, a man in imperial robes slowly walked out, surrounded by everyone, looking mighty and extraordinary.

The man walked slowly to the center of the camp, on the high platform that had been set up long ago, a burst of purple and gold light emerged from his hand, and he pointed forward, a flash of light flashed, forming a yellow and yellow cloth like silk.

If you stare carefully, you can find that it looks like a blank imperial decree, but it is in the form of a purple-gold airflow composed of true energy, which looks a little illusory, as if it can be dissipated by the wind, but it is extremely Condensed, standing there abruptly!

Looking at the blank imperial decree, he slowly said through his own lips what Zhong Yu had already familiarized himself with.

"Following the fate of the heavens, the emperor's edict said: Today there is a god of barbarians in barren land, who offends the power of heaven, arouses the anger of the heavens, causes the color of the world to change, the mountains and rivers collapse, and the people are terrified. .”

With every word Zhong Yu uttered, the corresponding words appeared on the blank imperial decree in front of his eyes, and the sky and the earth also changed accordingly, the sky became turbulent and gloomy, and all kinds of visions followed. out.

"The emperor said: Er god is guilty, heaven and man will attack together!"

Afterwards, following the last words from Zhong Yu's mouth, an illusory giant eye appeared in the sky, and various visions of people worshiping the emperor appeared in the midair. Then there was a surge, but they all pointed at God Edel who was restrained in mid-air.

A burst of crisis spontaneously emerged in the hearts of many gods, but they were so horrified that they wished to leave this place that made them feel dangerous immediately.

But their curiosity about what will happen next forced them to suppress their sense of crisis, and they stopped to watch the next direction of the matter!

They want to see how this mortal emperor, whom they regard as an ant, will give them such a sense of threat?
